acceptance.assertion: Given the generated profile and locked source, when configuration consumers load it, every native key is consumed by its intended subsystem and unsupported or ignored keys fail validation.

existingBehavior.onlyToyOwnedConfigSource: behavior/models.yaml is a strict JSON-shaped model-policy source; packages/contracts/src/model-route.ts uses strict objects for it and packages/hermes/src/model-route.ts reads it in ModelRoute.select(). Unknown fields in this model-policy source are rejected.
existingBehavior.publicInterface: packages/hermes/src/public.ts exports ModelRoute and ModelRouteProbe. The public route selects role/arm settings and normalizes external provider receipts. The registered model-policy probe covers role/arm selection and stream outcomes for AT-hermes-config-1/40/76/77, not a full native Hermes profile.
existingBehavior.profileCliUse: The auth fixture invokes public Hermes config get/set for isolated auth cases, but there is no Toy-owned profile renderer or full-profile validator connected to those commands.
existingBehavior.documentOnlyTarget: The complete Toy target config and claimed locked Hermes baseline are described in specs/hermes-config.md section 3. No in-repository source generates that complete YAML, no typed inventory maps all native keys to their intended consumers, and no assigned probe invokes the full configuration consumers against it.
existingBehavior.oldEvidenceLimit: build/evidence/R0.K4/managed-profile.json is an old doctor snapshot with profile delivery pending; it is not a generated profile or proof of key consumption.
existingBehavior.registrationGap: AT-hermes-config-75 is indexed, but tests/registry.yaml has no authored CLI acceptance manifest for it, ModelRouteProbe does not accept the ID, and fixture-stack has no route for it. Generated CLI inventory output must come from the authored registry, never a direct generated-file edit.

smallestImplementation.gapType: Missing Toy-owned behavior, not an external approval blocker.
smallestImplementation.publicSurface: Add one `HermesProfile` generate/validate operation to the existing packages/hermes owner and export it through packages/hermes/src/public.ts. Keep it within the existing package and reuse the existing Toy CLI probe command; add no service, protocol, dependency, or CLI command.
smallestImplementation.sourceAndValidation: Compose the documented canonical behavior/models.yaml, behavior/attention.yaml, behavior/budgets.yaml and existing protected/module fragments into a generated target profile. Give the generated target a strict schema and an explicit native-key-to-consumer inventory derived from the already locked Hermes revision. Refuse any extra, ignored, or unowned key before profile load; do not treat raw key round-trip as proof of consumer use.
smallestImplementation.contractAndGeneratedFiles: If a new public result is required, author its schema in packages/contracts, add it to schemaInventory, then regenerate contracts. Regenerate the CLI manifest from tests/registry.yaml with scripts/generate-contracts.mjs; do not hand-edit generated files.
smallestImplementation.staticChecks: Check that each rendered key has exactly one documented consumer entry and the profile source digest/locked revision match the generated result.
smallestImplementation.honestScope: The model-route strict schema already enforces its own source keys but cannot be relabeled as full native-profile support. AT-hermes-config-75 remains incomplete until the complete profile source and consumer inventory are implemented and exercised.

assignedCliProof.unfilteredRun: On a fresh owned fake R0 stack, run `toy --env test --stack <stack-id> probe run AT-hermes-config-75 --request-id <uuid> --json` without a case filter. Through the existing Hermès public CLI/config-consumer path in an isolated disposable profile, load the full generated profile and test one representative valid key per intended subsystem; submit unsupported and documented-but-ignored key variants and require pre-load validation refusal.
assignedCliProof.readback: Use the public probe show operation to inspect every mandatory cell, generated profile digest, locked revision, key-to-consumer inventory, and refusal reason. The receipt must state live profile, account, secret, and provider state were untouched.
assignedCliProof.teardown: Use public stack down and retain the teardown receipt. Run the static source-map check required by the TEST-PLAN row; do not count profile generation or expected negative-cell handling as whole-AT completion.

deferredPrerequisites.lockedSourceCompatibility: The planning record names baseline Hermes revision 8d5e3e412138342e8bf30443e72bd4e6a9abd057, but this task did not inspect upstream/installed source. The implementation proof must use the already locked local source and record which actual native consumer handles each key; a prose pin alone is not compatibility evidence.
deferredPrerequisites.productionPublication: No actual user profile inventory, backup/diff, protected publication, account, credentials, or service change is authorized or implied by this static/fixture plan.
deferredPrerequisites.otherAssertions: AT-hermes-config-76 through 83 and live authentication/inference, profile publication, gateway and protected-executor gates remain independent. No R0 release or whole acceptance promotion is implied.

workPerformed: Read-only inspection of the assigned acceptance, Toy sources/contracts, tests, feature map, and recorded evidence. No upstream/external/kernel/ABI research, source or planning edit, contract generation, build, test, stack, root, runtime, secret, or actual-user-config action was performed.

missingConfigSourceFacts: Protected/module fragments are not implemented by this source unit
parentReview.scope: Read only the exact documented native keys and necessary already-locked local consumers after the failed assigned baseline; do not implement other owners or invent ignored keys. Write the existing-module interface and strict canonical result first. No research beyond the failing check, no service/publication/credentials or paid sends.
parentReview.sourceValidationRequirement: Raw get/set or round-trip is insufficient. Bind each key to the actual locked consumer and preserve full native/protected gates until exercised.
